name: Vladimir Putin
quote: Right now we're observing a certain shortage, but it's not critical.

name: Dmitry Peskov
quote: Discussions are actively being held. If agreements can be reached at acceptable price points, then [gasoline imports] will move forward.

name: Mikhail Mishustin
quote: Signed the July 2, 2026 decree authorizing refineries to produce lower-grade Euro-3 gasoline through the end of the year to stabilize domestic supply.

name: Alexander Novak
quote: We are redirecting supply to the domestic market — a full ban on diesel exports is under consideration to stabilize the situation.

name: Sergey Aksyonov
quote: Signed the decree declaring a state of emergency across Crimea and Sevastopol, effective 1:00 p.m., June 26, 2026, amid the fuel and energy crisis.

name: Igor Kobzev
quote: Presided over Irkutsk's state-of-emergency fuel measures, including installation of portable toilets to accommodate motorists waiting hours in gas station queues.

name: German Gref
quote: I don't believe there is anyone in this country whose primary concern is anything other than an end to military hostilities.

name: Tatarstan Ministry of Agriculture
quote: Farms always need to have some [fuel stockpiles] — we're advising 10-day to two-week reserves through harvest season.

name: Boris Aronstein
quote: The size, coordination and repeated waves of the drones make Russia unable to repair the refineries before the next attack occurs.

name: Igor Lipsits
quote: Russia does not have the capacity to repair the oil refineries destroyed by Ukrainian drones at the pace they are being struck.

name: Craig Kennedy
quote: This is the worst crisis in Russia's energy sector since the 1990s.

name: Volodymyr Zelensky
quote: In addition to bombing oil refineries, Russia is shooting at any route, including the railway and bridges, to stop us getting either diesel or gasoline.

name: Alexander Stubb
quote: Russian refining and export capacity has been reduced by roughly 40 percent by the strike campaign.

name: Institute for the Study of War
quote: Putin's remarks acknowledged the effects of Ukraine's long-range strike campaign but sought to dismiss concerns and promote a facade of stability.

name: Irkutsk motorist (unnamed)
quote: We wait for hours in line just to fill up — some stations even put in portable toilets because the queues take so long.

name: Yevgeny Solntsev
quote: The plant has completely shut down. Shrapnel damaged key infrastructure that cannot be quickly repaired due to Western sanctions on imported equipment — repairs could take up to six months.

name: Radiy Khabirov
role: Head of the Republic of Bashkortostan
quote: A unit undergoing maintenance was hit. As always, falling debris damages pipes, so there's minor damage.

name: Dmitry Makhonin
quote: Air defense systems downed 16 Ukrainian drones during the overnight attack; an industrial facility was damaged and one man was injured.
